back: Finalizes all activities of a project, phase, release, iteration or contract, successful or not; archives, completes work, releases resources, confirms value.
Lessons learned register updates, final product, service or result transition, final report, organizational process asset updates.
Expert judgment; document, regression, trend and variance analysis; meetings.
Documents updated, issues resolved, value delivered and maintained, formal acceptance, costs charged, accounts closed, resources released, final reports.
Closure still happens, with procedures to investigate and document why the project was terminated.
Validated by an appointed person or group against criteria; the approver is involved early and gives feedback on quality.

front: Prepare for Transition to Future State
back: Decides whether the organization is ready and how it moves to the future state, so the solution is adopted.

Operational procedures, training, service-level agreements, rollout material, coordination with other releases, contingency plans.

back: Handing the result to the group that will operate, maintain and support it, or to the next phase.
Accepted, or transitioned to operations (or to later releases in adaptive work).
Formal acceptance, claims and warranties finalized, invoices paid, records updated and archived, disputes resolved or referred.

Verify that all costs are charged to the project; close the project accounts.
Reassign or release personnel; deal with excess materials; release facilities and equipment.
Knowledge gained (situation, impact, recommendations); created early and updated throughout, finalized at closure.
Collect and audit records, assess success, transfer knowledge, archive, forward improvement suggestions, measure satisfaction.

Scope, quality, cost and schedule results with variances; validation; benefits and business needs met; risks and issues.

back: The final report states the degree achieved and an estimate for future realization.

Prioritized items finished, acceptance criteria met, deliverables accepted, final review, retrospective, risks discussed.
